## Not my cup of tea

**Word Power 51 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Not what I like; not what suits me.

### Usage

1. He is nice enough, but not my cup of tea.
2. Playing the same role in a show for five years was not my cup of tea.

### Your turn

Use “not my cup of tea” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
